title: test incident that will be resolved
Seeing elevated 500s on checkoutservice starting ~10 min ago

payload.full_text:
Seeing elevated 500s on checkoutservice starting ~10 min ago
<!here> anyone on call? Pager just went off for boutique/paymentservice
Rolling back the 14:30 deploy — it was the cause
Confirmed: reverting the payment API timeout change fixed it
Postmortem doc here: [link]
